name: Spark Drop
description: Restores 5 Energy to the active Spirling.

name: Revival Leaf
description: Revives a Spirling outside battle with half HP.

name: Kin Charm
description: Hold it out during a bond to steady the link (+10%).

name: Grapple Line
description: Tamer Gear. Face a far post across narrow water and press A to pull yourself over.
hint: The far side is just out of reach. A grapple line could bridge it.

name: Climbing Pick
description: Tamer Gear. Face a low cliff and press A to climb up or down it.
hint: A steep rock face. With a climbing pick you could get a grip.

name: Storm Lantern
description: Tamer Gear. Lights pitch-dark places so you can walk through them.
hint: It's pitch dark ahead. A lantern would help.

name: Spark Coil
description: Held. The holder gains 1 extra Energy every turn.

name: Bark Wrap
description: Held. The holder recovers a little HP at the end of each turn.

name: Iron Burr
description: Held. Physical hits on the holder deal 15% less damage.

name: Swift Feather
description: Held. Raises the holder's SPD by 15%.

name: Keen Lens
description: Held. The holder lands keen hits twice as often.
